column1: # The static initialisers at 0x51fd00 up to 0x522438: MWCC names each `__sinit_<file>` after the source file
# whose global objects it constructs, and the owning file's whole-file row in unit-objects.json names it in
# `emitted` at this address. Evidence in docs/engine/emitted-functions.md (Static initialisers).
